name: limits-statusline
description: Status line for Claude Code: the 5-hour and weekly plan usage limits with recent pace, usage projected to the reset, reset countdown and a red warning with the time left when a limit would run out first, plus session cost, runtime, prompt cache, effort, project, git and model, and context fill.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Where the plugin draws its band above the prompt: desktop (only in the desktop app; the terminal has the status line at the bottom), all (desktop app and terminal) or off. Any other value means desktop.
